name: docs-header
title: Docs header
description: The top bar of a documentation site: brand, a row of section links, a search field and icon links, folding into a menu on a phone.
docs: brand, sections and currentHref fill the two rows; the section whose href matches currentHref is underlined and carries aria-current="page". The sections are plain links, not an ARIA tablist, because each one goes to another page. onSearchOpen opens your own command palette from the field and from the shortcut (shortcutKey, Ctrl or Command and K), so use the header from a Client Component, next to the palette. links are icon links to the repository or the community: they open in a new tab and say so, and below md they fold into one menu. children is one compact control at the end of the first row, a theme toggle or a version select, and it stays on a phone. Both rows are sticky; set sticky={false} to let them scroll. labels translates the fixed words and linkAs renders your router's Link.
